caseNameFull: North Coast Transportation Co. v. United States

Hennessy, and Nelson Thomas for the United States et al., Mr. Arthur H. Glam for the West Coast Bus Lines, Ltd., and Messrs. Jonathan C. Gibson and Russell B. James for the National Trailways System et al., appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

In No. 274 the appeal is dismissed. Hudson & Manhattan R. Co. v. Jersey City, 321 U. S. 755, and cases cited. In No. 275 the motions to affirm are granted and the judgment is affirmed. (1) Chesapeake & Ohio R. Co. v. United States, 283 U. S. 35, 42; (2) United States v. Baltimore & Ohio R. Co., 293 U. S. 454, 465; (3) Interstate Commerce Commission v. Jersey City, 322 U. S. 503.
